WOD20TH -- World of Darkness 20th Anniversary

  Character creation, stats, rolling, and advancement for WoD 20th.

COMMANDS
  +chargen            Open your character sheet / chargen dashboard.
  +sheet [<player>]   View your sheet (or another player's, if staff).
  +roll <pool>        Roll a dice pool.
  +stat <trait>=<n>   Set a stat (staff only).
  +xp                 View your XP balance.
  +hurt me=<dmg>      Apply damage to yourself.

SEE ALSO: +help chargen, +help sheet, +help stat, +help roll,
  +help rolling, +help xp, +help hurt, +help heal, +help moniker,
